name: Per-hop RTT, capacity, interference, recovery
description: After the network has formed and is stable: per-hop RTT baseline; capacity search until the RTT p95 doubles, the maximum RTT reaches 5 s or the delivery ratio falls below 95 %; at 80 % of that capacity, 120 s without interferer as the reference, then an interferer on half of the channels; recovery after its removal, until the RTT p95 is back within 1.2 times the reference.
